lines: Ah, honeyed past honey, the foretaste of waiting on the Gracious —
where, in what tick, turns it not ever-new?
l4.sanskrit_cite: aho svādutamaḥ śarvasevāśaṃsāsudhārasaḥ kutra kālakalāmātre na yo navanavāyate
